recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7614 unless Patient Care later reopens the broader Condition.encounter modeling question.
issue_request: FHIR-7614 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification for a DSTU1 Patient Care request to rename Condition.encounter to firstEncounter; the approved action was to add a usage note rather than rename the element.
initial_application: Git commit 80c713db6273e0fea9b46a4890014f59a01856de on 2015-08-24 explicitly applied #7614 by adding the approved usage note to source/condition/condition-spreadsheet.xml. Later source refactors moved Condition into source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml while preserving the note.
additional_context: Condition is active and approved in source/fhir.ini, making source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml current build-scope source. FHIR-7905 raised the same semantic concern and was closed as Duplicate. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later core FHIR decision that reverses or conflicts with the current usage note.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already satisfies the FHIR-7614 resolution.

related_jiras.note: Raised the same concern that Condition.encounter should not imply the first assessment encounter and was closed as Duplicate, so it supports the interpretation but was not decided separately.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Not Persuasive with Modification issue requested renaming Condition.encounter to firstEncounter but approved adding a usage note instead.
evidence_items.learned: Final WG intent was clarification that Condition.encounter is record-associated and not necessarily the first encounter where the underlying condition was known.

evidence_items.summary: Current Condition.encounter includes the usage note distinguishing this record's encounter from the first known encounter.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current source already satisfies the approved FHIR-7614 clarification.

evidence_items.summary: Condition is listed as an active resource and approved item in fhir.ini.
evidence_items.learned: The inspected Condition StructureDefinition is in current build scope.

evidence_items.summary: 2015 commit subject explicitly says #7614 usage notes were added to the encounter field and the patch adds the approved note to the Condition spreadsheet.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-7614 was historically applied before later source refactors carried the note into the current StructureDefinition source.

evidence_items.summary: Duplicate DSTU1 issue said Condition.encounter should not imply the first assessment encounter because systems more often track encounter-context diagnoses.
evidence_items.learned: The duplicate reinforces the same semantic concern but does not require a separate commit.

evidence_items.locator: Negative Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches for FHIR-7614 and Condition encounter firstEncounter
evidence_items.command: bun run jira:search fts '"Condition.encounter" firstEncounter' --limit 10; bun run jira:search fts 'Condition encounter "first identified"' --limit 10; bun run zulip:search fts 'Condition encounter firstEncounter' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-7614; bun run confluence:search fts 'Condition encounter firstEncounter' --limit 10
evidence_items.summary: Exact Jira searches returned FHIR-7614; Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence, and Confluence refs found no FHIR-7614 pages.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered later community or Jira evidence changes the source/history conclusion.
